QUOTE: The right side is matched against the tool name plus the first string value in the args JSON (`ServerManager::args_to_pattern`, `server_manager.cpp:426`). Empty args, `{}`, or a non-string first value all become `*`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that only the first string arg value reaches the pattern and that empty or non-string values collapse to `*`. It doesn't say outright that the other arguments are invisible, but "the first string value" implies it.
